gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-thai: Round, bubbly, and drawn like a rolling-ball pen: that's Autour One up top. Noto Sans Thai takes over with swollen, glass-bead lowercase and rounded shapes left open, where the heading shows off and this one settles in.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-waran: Funnel Display looks like a bent paperclip, every stroke the same width and no thick-thin shifts. Noto Sans Warang Citi has wide channels into each counter, so the heading does the shouting while the body packs words into solid blocks.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans reads like bent copper pipe, with big washer-round lowercase eyes and curves that stop before the loop closes. Paprika, by contrast, is loud and scattered, its lowercase filling the line like capitals, so the two feel like a shout beside a hum.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-yaldevi: Expressive and loose, Revalia strides across widely separated letters, its lowercase g leaving the lower curve open. Yaldevi follows with large-bodied lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, so a long read stays smooth.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-vend-sans: Stencil-cut and tall, Snowburst One breaks its letters with wide bridges. Vend Sans keeps a ruler-straight line with generous curve endings, and its x-height fills the line, so you can size it down without losing presence.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-tiktok-sans: Commanding from the first glance, Tilt Neon is built from tube-like strokes. TikTok Sans has a tall x-height and a spacious opening on the c, so a longer passage moves along easily without ever crowding the eye.
gen-almendra-display-archivo: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display has a pronounced x-height and letters that never pinch shut. Archivo brings its own tall lowercase and curves opening outward, so the heading sets the scene while the body does the talking.
gen-fs-chubbo-zilla-slab: Zilla Slab reads sturdy and technical, with a broad opening on every curve that ends in a bowl. And Chubbo, drawn as if with a marker tip, is the casual one, best at inviting you in while the slab-serif does the steady work.
gen-gf-offside-gf-sen: Sen is modern and tall in the lowercase, with a constant-weight line and curves that end before turning inward. Sen's openness meets Offside's widely tracked, level beat, and that quiet restraint is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-sintony: Big-lowercase confidence, that's Oxanium, with monoline strokes and curves ending in clear daylight. And Sintony adds a chunky, tall midzone with smooth curves that never clog, which is the pair's strongest quality.
